name: Cybersecurity Vulnerability Audit Scanner
description: OWASP, Nuclei, and Burp Suite inspired security auditing tool with YAML automation templates, PDF reports, Discord/Slack webhooks, Linux/WSL CLI, daily scheduled scans, Subfinder drag-and-drop batch scanning, modular extension packs, and upstream proxy configuration (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Tor).
